proof_scope: Herdr runtime backend support for Tau-owned headless agent-node worker endpoints

claims.does_not_prove: Provider semantic quality, Textual/React UI rendering, full scheduler restart adoption, or GOAL.md completion.
claims.proves: Tau can run live Herdr-hosted headless worker endpoints for agent-node style work, keep exact workspace/pane leases, observe liveness, read settlement receipts from disk, and clean up exact owned endpoints through authorization-bound termination.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Tau-owned headless agent-node workers can run through the live Herdr runtime backend as exact leased endpoints while Tau retains endpoint ownership, observation, worker settlement receipts, and cleanup authority.

cases.name: live-herdr-hosts-two-tau-headless-agent-node-workers
argv: cd .. && mkdir -p local/agentic-evals/tau-herdr-agent-node-backend && rm -rf local/agentic-evals/tau-herdr-agent-node-backend/work && uv run python scripts/agentic-eval-tau-herdr-agent-node-backend.py --work local/agentic-evals/tau-herdr-agent-node-backend/work --out local/agentic-evals/tau-herdr-agent-node-backend/proof.json
